entries.title: Mario Could Jump/Walk Onto Solid Hedges ('mario ne peut pas marcher sur la haie')
entries.root_cause: STZ $29 (0x00, positive) caused ALTTP $07:86D1 (LDA $29; BPL +$3C) to bypass solid-tile collision JSR $D077 on every airborne frame.
entries.fix: Replaced STZ $29 with LDA #$FF; STA $29 across all airborne & jump hooks in mario_engine.rs.

entries.title: Warp Pipe Animation Glitches & Hedge-Blocked Hub 1 Pipe
entries.root_cause: W_PIPE_STATE did not freeze Link_Control ($02E4) before JSL $07:8000, and Toad Town Hub 1 pipe at 0x19 (12,3) sat behind a solid hedge.
entries.fix: Pre-hook locks $02E4=1, zeroes $F0..$F6, locks facing Down ($2F=2), animates smooth 7px vertical descent & Z-altitude pop-out hop; moved Hub 1 pipe to open Star Plaza 0x19 (14,1).

entries.title: Vanilla Dome Enemy Stuck Inside Warp Pipe ('ennemi prit dans objet') + Olive Boulder Halos
entries.root_cause: FR PAL Bank $09 Area 0x03 spawns Deadrock/Spiny 0x27 at (y16=53,x16=10) = Screen 0x0B (r10,c05), colliding directly with v0.10.0's pipe; 0x0DE654 BGColor0 retained vanilla olive 0x2A53.
entries.fix: Added compile-time Bank $09 enemy-spawn exclusion map across all 128 OW screens (3 phases + 1-tile halo), moved Hub 2 pipe to 0x0B (9,2), added runtime Mario_UnstickEnemies guard, and patched 0x0DE654->0x36BB + OWMainPal[2] + OWAuxPal.

entries.title: Toad Town Monument Leftover Rooster Head/Arrow & Red Star Indices
entries.root_cause: m16 0x41A/0x41D held rooster head (0x10D/0x11D/0x12D) and m16 0x437 held arrow tail (0x1DE); AuxRow 0 uses indices 5/6 for red, 4/7 for gold/white.
entries.fix: Cleared Map16 0x41A/0x41D/0x437 weathervane parts to grass 0x0CED and repainted raw 0x53 cols 14..15 using pure gold/white star + royal red velvet cushion.

entries.title: Lake Cheep-Cheep (Slot 9) Whirlpool Clip During Pipe Emergence
entries.root_cause: Shifting $20 += 7px South at warp arrival dipped Mario into Lake Cheep-Cheep's south-west whirlpool trigger.
entries.fix: Removed Y-offset on emergence and animated an authentic coordinate-safe $24 Z-altitude SMW Pop-Out Parabolic Hop (0->14->0px).

entries.title: ALTTP New-File Creation Wrote 0xFF into $7E:F405/$7E:F406
entries.root_cause: Vanilla File Select initializes +$0405/+$0406 to 0xFF on new files.
entries.fix: Mario_InitOrVerifySramV2 sanitizes S_PIPE_DISC >= 0x20 and S_DRAGON_CNT >= 0x21 while preserving real v0.10.0 legacy saves.

entries.title: Ground Pound Down Input Overwrote $2F Before Bidirectional Pipe Check
entries.root_cause: Pressing Down mid-air for Ground Pound caused ALTTP to set $2F=2 before landing impact.
entries.fix: Latched takeoff direction $2F into W_PIPE_STEP at jump initiation (init_jump_state) and widened Hub 1 pipe X-zone to $01E8..$0257.
